text.p: MEI Holdings LP said Wednesday it purchased in tender offers 7.8 million Mountasia Entertainment International Inc common shares and $15.1 million aggregate principal amount of the company's convertible debentures.

Describing itself as Mountasia's largest shareholder, MEI Holdings said that until shareholders approve conversion of the debentures and certain other Mountasia equity securities held by MEI Holdings, the common shares purchased in the tender offer are subject to voting restrictions.
It also said the debentures are convertible into non-voting equity securities until these changes are made.

Assuming such shareholder approval and therefore treating all the equity securities presently beneficially owned by MEI Holdings as common stock equivalents, MEI Holdings said, it would beneficially own 81.0 percent of Mountasia's outstanding common. Prior to such shareholder approval, these equity securities represent 49.9 percent of the presently total outstanding ordinary voting power of Mountasia.
MEI Holdings' 81 percent ownership also assumes:
(i) the conversion of all debentures purchased in the tender offers at $3.50 per share,

(ii) the completion of the previously announced capital call by Mountasia on MEI Holdings for $22.7 million of additional capital at MEI Holdings' average per share investment price for its initial investment last year, and

(iii) the assumed issuance of 2.0 million of additional shares to MEI Holdings under the post-closing adjustment provisions of the investment agreement entered into by MEI Holdings and Mountasia last year.
